span.p:
MetadataManager::create
生成 MetadataEntry{data_id=uuid,data_size,
created_at,modified_at,owner,hashes,
metadata,parent_id,tags}

chain.add_metadata → pending
Storage::save_pending_metadata
pending_metadata(data_id PK, data=JSON)

GET /api/v1/metadata?owner=&tags=
Storage::query_metadata
SELECT data WHERE owner=? AND created_at BETWEEN
→ 应用层过滤 tag/分页

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
build_verified_key_transaction
register 须自签(signed_by==target_key)
verify_base64(signed_by, signing_payload, signature)
signing_payload = tx_type|target_key|role|label|signed_by

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
chain.add_key_transaction → pending_key_tx
KeyTransactionEntry{...,timestamp=服务端now}

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /identity/keys (RBAC BlockRead)
replay_key_set(all blocks)
register→insert active / revoke→remove
→ Vec KeyRecord

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /chain/mine → Chain::mine_block
取 pending(≤block_size)+全部 pending_key_tx

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Block{index,timestamp,previous_hash,
metadata_list,key_transactions,nonce,difficulty,hash}
mine(): merkle_root=build_merkle_root(
metadata.map SHA256(data_id) ++ key_tx.map leaf_hash)
PoW nonce++ 直到 hash 前缀 difficulty 个0
挖后 identity_snapshot_hash=
compute_identity_snapshot_hash(replay_key_set(all))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Storage::commit_block 单事务
INSERT blocks(block_index,timestamp,previous_hash,
merkle_root,nonce,difficulty,hash,data=整块JSON)
FOR metadata: DELETE pending_metadata
+ UPSERT metadata(data_id PK,owner,data_size,
created_at,block_index,tags,data)

span.p:
POST /crosschain/anchor/:data_id (RBAC BlockMine)
查 data_id 所在 block + MerkleProof

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AnchorService::enqueue_anchor
ChainAnchor{anchor_id,source_chain_id,source_node_id,
target_chain_id,data_id,block_hash,merkle_root,
proof(leaf,leaf_index,siblings,sibling_is_left,root),created_at}
sign_base64(signing_payload)
payload=anchor_id|src_chain|src_node|tgt_chain|
data_id|block_hash|merkle_root|proof.root

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Storage::enqueue_anchor
anchor_outbox(anchor_id PK,target_chain_id,data_id,
signed=JSON,status=pending,attempts=0,receipt)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
worker 每30s process_pending
connector.deliver→HttpAttestationConnector
POST anchor_endpoint(Bearer token)
成功→AnchorReceipt{anchor_id,target_chain_id,
target_ref,confirmed_at} status=confirmed
失败→attempts+1, ≥8→failed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: GET /crosschain/anchor/status/:anchor_id

span.p: 外部认证链 / attestation 服务

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
权威根: 区块+merkle_root+PoW
投影表/outbox/回执均为派生或旁路
identity_snapshot_hash 不进 PoW、不进锚定 payload
merkle_root 只覆盖本区块;可信根靠外链锚定(内部不共识)
L2 多外链/L3 进展回写/L4 失信切换/L5 封存重启 未实现
